summary.text: Gex Williams is a Republican state senator who has represented District 20 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gex Williams, also known as Jay, graduated from Fort Lauderdale High School in 1970 and earned a bachelor's degree in computer and information sciences and a master's degree in electrical engineering from the University of Florida in 1975 and 1977.
His career experience includes working as an IT consultant with Wi2, an executive advisor with the Commonwealth of Kentucky, and vice president and insurance agent with Capitol Marketing Insurance.
He has been affiliated with the NRA, Christian Home Educators of Kentucky, and Boy Scouts of America.
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Senate Natural Resources and Energy Committee and serves on the Education, Families and Children, and Transportation committees.
